description: Zero‑dependency, TypeScript‑first framework that blends Express simplicity, Fastify performance, and AI‑driven routing for Node, Bun, Deno & Cloudflare Workers—ready for the edge‑first era.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverages the 2026 surge in AI‑augmented back‑ends and edge computing by offering built‑in LLM‑powered route generation, zero‑dependency deployment across Node, Bun, Deno, and Cloudflare Workers, and out‑of‑the‑box observability (HTTP/3, QUIC, WebGPU, WASM). The package ships with a single‑file, tree‑shakable bundle that scores top‑tier latency benchmarks while keeping the developer experience as simple as Express.
download_hooks: Developers choose yantravese for AI‑driven routing that auto‑generates performant endpoints from natural‑language prompts—cutting weeks of boilerplate.
Benchmarks show 2× lower latency vs Fastify on HTTP/3 + QUIC edge nodes, making it the go‑to choice for low‑latency, real‑time apps.
Zero‑dependency, TypeScript‑first API delivers IDE autocompletion, type‑safe middleware, and instant observability without extra packages, so you can ship full‑stack services in minutes.
